description: Plan or run the canonical app-aware `run402 up` workflow from a local path or repo URL: any missing setup (wallet, tier, project, workspace link), then the deploy. Delegates to the SDK and returns the shared up result envelope with graph steps, resources, diagnostics, and next_actions. `deploy` only deploys.

allow_shell_build.description: Approve shell-string build commands after review.

dir.description: Workspace directory to inspect when source is omitted.

display_name.description: Display name to set on this principal (promotion credit and room presence use it); overrides an existing name. Omitted: RUN402_AGENT_NAME when set (same effect); else, only when the principal has no name yet, the detected client name (claude-code, codex, cursor, or grok; RUN402_CLIENT=<name> declares one that is not auto-detected) is set and reported as identity.source "detected"; otherwise nothing is written (identity.source "undetected", room presence 'agent' for coordination only). A detected client that was not applied is still reported under identity.detected / identity.detection.

dry_run.description: Plan only. No gateway mutation, build execution, release commit, local link write, or prune.

idempotency_key.description: Root idempotency key for resumable app-up graph mutations.

manifest.description: Explicit manifest path. Defaults to run402.json, then advanced release-only manifests.

max_spend_usd.description: Maximum spend up may approve for readiness steps.

name.description: Project/app instance name, for example kysigned2.

no_rehearse.description: Skip the automatic rehearsal. By default a migration-bearing deploy against a project with a live release is rehearsed on a contained branch and committed only on a passing report; a first deploy has nothing to protect and commits directly, and a plan whose migrations are all already applied with an identical checksum is not rehearsed either (result.deploy.rehearsal says which: no_live_release / migrations_unchanged / no_migrations).

project_id.description: Existing project id to install into.

source.description: Local app directory or public Git repository URL. Defaults to the current directory.

tier.description: Bootstrap tier if account readiness is needed.

yes.description: Approve non-interactive prerequisite, spend, and local-write prompts.

name: up
